title: Documents se jawab - source ke saath
content:
Aapke documents se sawaal poocho... aur jawab ke saath PAGE number bhi milega.
No guessing. Every answer shows its source.
Aaj main dikhata hoon ki ye assistant kaise build karte hain.
Ye ek build walkthrough hai, step by step.
Problem simple hai.
Company ke paas sau PDFs hain... policies, SOPs, contracts.
Koi bhi ek line dhoondhne mein aadha ghanta laga deta hai.
A normal chatbot will just make up an answer.
Humein aisa assistant chahiye jo bataye... ye jawab KAHAN se aaya.
Step ONE... documents ko chhote chunks mein todo.
Har chunk ke saath file ka naam aur page number save karo.
This metadata is what makes citations possible later.
Isko skip kiya, toh source kabhi nahi dikha paoge.
Step TWO... har chunk ka embedding banao aur vector database mein daalo.
Chroma jaisa open-source vector database kaam karega.
Embedding matlab text ka meaning, numbers ki form mein.
So when a user asks a question, we find the chunks with the closest meaning.
Par asli twist yahan hai...
Zyada demos yahin ruk jaate hain. Aur yahin galti hoti hai.
Step THREE... model ko strict instruction do.
Sirf in chunks se jawab do, aur har line ke saath source likho.
If the answer is not in the documents, say "I don't know."
LlamaIndex jaisa framework ye retrieval aur citation flow easy bana deta hai.
"I don't know" bolna is assistant ka sabse important feature hai.
Step FOUR... test karo.
Maan lo aapne bees asli sawaal likhe, jinke jawab aapko already pata hain.
Check karo... jawab sahi hai? Source sahi page pe hai?
Wrong source is worse than no answer.
Jo fail ho, wahi aapka next improvement hai.
Mera take simple hai... ye project hiring ke liye bahut strong hai.
Because every company has documents, and every company has this problem.
Aur jab aap source dikhate ho, log AI pe trust karna shuru karte hain.
Chhota shuru karo... das PDFs se.
Dono tools ke links chahiye? Comment CITE and I'll DM you the links.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
